summary: Deschutes NF, Lake County, OR: L-4 cab built 1931; site gone, but the cab was moved to Fox Butte in 1948 and stood there on a 2021 visit.

facts.design: L-4 cab on the ground at the Sixteen Butte site; moved to Fox Butte in 1948
facts.status_note: The Sixteen Butte site is gone. Its L-4 cab was moved to Fox Butte in 1948 and was still there at a 2021 visit, in disrepair.

access.note: The cab is at Fox Butte, where the road is locked about three-quarters of the way up; a 2021 visitor walked the rest. No source describes access to the Sixteen Butte site.

events.note: L-4 cab built (register). Bend Bulletin item: lookout houses built in the 1931 field season, including Sixteen Butte (weebly).
April 1931: Fox Butte fireman to be shifted to Sixteen Butte. May 1931: lookout road up the butte completed (weebly).
L-4 cab moved from Sixteen Butte to Fox Butte; it is the present ground cabin there (register, firelookout.com, NHLR Fox Butte)
Registered June 10, 2011 as FFLOS US 1043, OR 401
2021 visit: cabin at Fox Butte had fallen into disrepair. The account says the Forest Service had proposed removing the tower and cabin.

notes_for_editor: The Fox Butte story (data/stories/us-or-fox-butte.md) covers the same cab and agrees with this one. The cab's current condition rests on one 2021 visit; no later source was read. The Forest Service disposal project is listed as cancelled in the Fox Butte story's sources, which was not re-checked here. Elevation differs (register 5,674 ft; firelookout.com 5,682 ft), so it is left out. The brief's status 'gone' is right for the Sixteen Butte site but hides the cab; a status_note is proposed rather than a correction.
